method: Each guard mutated alone in the working tree, the named test run alone (vitest -t), the file restored and its SHA-256 compared with the original, then the test rerun. Integration tests ran on local PostgreSQL 18.6 with the real schema; PayPal is the labeled fixture fake at the PayPalWriteClient boundary.
